comment: The REDDHI open standards list (line 148) and surrounding text reference SNOMED CT, ICD-11, and LOINC as a group without articulating that these are complementary, not interchangeable, standards. Each occupies a distinct clinical domain: SNOMED CT covers clinical concepts and findings; ICD-11-MMS supports morbidity/mortality classification and reimbursement; LOINC standardises laboratory and clinical observation identifiers. A country implementing only one of these three would produce a functionally incomplete Terminology Service. The current grouping may lead national programmes to conclude that any single standard satisfies the architectural requirement.

public.suggestedRevision: Add a clarifying sentence following the open standards list: "These standards are complementary rather than interchangeable: SNOMED CT provides clinical concept and procedural coverage; ICD-11 MMS supports mortality and morbidity classification; LOINC provides universal identifiers for laboratory tests and clinical observations. A complete national Terminology Service typically requires all three, operating together."
